page_title: BET 2-1 OSA | Betis v Osasuna 29/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Jose Sanchez has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+8' Betis take a short corner kick.
90+4' 2 - 1 Goal! Isco (Betis) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top of the net. It's 2:1.
90+3' Betis take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+2' Assane Diao (Betis) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
90+2' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
90+2' Sergio Herrera (Osasuna) is the one who receives a yellow card.
90+2' Assane Diao (Betis) attempts to discuss the decision with Jose Sanchez, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Jose Sanchez interrupts the game. One of the players from Osasuna won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) comes onto the pitch for Ante Budimir.
87' Manuel Pellegrini decides to make a substitution. Marc Roca will be replaced by William Carvalho (Betis).
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Juan Miranda trots off the pitch and is replaced by Abner (Betis).
85' 1 - 1 Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) latched on to a sweet pass and coolly slotted the ball inside the right post.
83' David Garcia (Osasuna) outbattles his marker to get a close-range header in on goal from the corner, but a defender unwittingly blocks the ball as it looked set to find the net.
83' Osasuna will take a corner kick.
81' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) gets a yellow card.
80' The foul by Moi Gomez (Osasuna) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Jose Sanchez.
79' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Betis comes to nothing.
79' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
77' Here's the change. Ruben Pena leaves the pitch and Kike Barja (Osasuna) comes on as a substitute.
77' Jagoba Arrasate prepares a substitution. Lucas Torro is replaced by Ruben Garcia (Osasuna).
76' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Isco (Betis) was quite harsh and Jose Sanchez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
75' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) is coming onto the pitch as Ayoze Perez cannot continue after picking up an injury.
74' Assane Diao (Betis) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
72' Osasuna force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
72' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
71' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Luiz Henrique (Betis) gets booked.

69' VAR review of the penalty decision hasn’t taken long and it’s NO PENALTY! The Betis players are stunned. Here comes the VAR decision and David Garcia (Osasuna) is back in the game as the red card is reversed!
68' Celebrations by Betis are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
66' The referee pulls out a yellow card and shows it to David Garcia (Osasuna). However, it's his second caution and therefore the match is over for him.
66' A player from Osasuna commits a rough challenge. Jose Sanchez blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. PENALTY! A huge scoring opportunity for Betis.
64' Substitution. Luiz Henrique (Betis) has come on for Willian Jose.
61' The resulting set piece from Betis is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
60' Juan Miranda (Betis) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
59' Juan Miranda received a sweet pass from Isco (Betis), but the advance is stopped.
56' A snap shot by Lucas Torro (Osasuna) from distance flies well wide of the right post.
54' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to David Garcia (Osasuna).
53' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar.

51' Willian Jose (Betis) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Sergio Herrera inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball into the middle of the target, but was denied by a great save.
50' Osasuna have a goal ruled out for offside!
48' Assane Diao (Betis) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Jagoba Arrasate makes a half-time substitution. Johan Mojica comes on in place of Jon Moncayola (Osasuna).
46' Half-time substitution. Jagoba Arrasate decided to make a change. Chimy Avila (Osasuna) is replaced by Raul.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' 1 - 0 Goal! Isco displays great vision and sends a pass to Willian Jose (Betis), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the top right corner. The score is 1:0.
44' A long ball forward to Ante Budimir (Osasuna) is intercepted.
41' Isco (Betis) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post.
38' A clumsy foul by Hector Bellerin (Betis) and Jose Sanchez blows his whistle.
38' Half-chance! Chimy Avila (Osasuna) plays a pass into the box, but Claudio Bravo reacts well to snuff out the attack.
36' Willian Jose (Betis) does well inside the box to bring down a pass from Assane Diao. He gets away a decent shot but it creeps just past the right post.
35' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Betis, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
34' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) tackles a bit over-zealously and Jose Sanchez blows for a foul.

33' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) rises high to head a nice lofted cross low towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Claudio Bravo makes a comfortable save.
32' Chimy Avila (Osasuna) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
30' Isco (Betis) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
29' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
29' Osasuna are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
27' Marc Roca (Betis) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot on goal, but the ball curls just wide of the right post.
27' Betis work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
25' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) probably handled the ball.
23' Juan Miranda (Betis) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
19' Jose Sanchez has a clear sight and sees a foul from Jesus Areso (Osasuna).
17' Assane Diao (Betis) turns on the edge of the box and immediately fires in a shot at goal, but the keeper can relax as it spins well wide of the left post.
14' Isco (Betis) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
14' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul. Betis win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
12' The Betis players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
10' Isco (Betis) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
9' Jose Sanchez couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Ruben Pena (Osasuna) and blew his whistle.
7' Chimy Avila (Osasuna) drills in an effort from the edge of the box that climbs rapidly and goes high over the bar.
6' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem.
3' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
3' An attempted cross from Chimy Avila (Osasuna) is cleared. The ball goes out of play. Osasuna are awarded a corner kick.
2' Isco (Betis) is penalised for a foul. Jose Sanchez had a clear view and blows his whistle.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Osasuna will kick the game off.
Jose Sanchez will supervise the game today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
Show lineups
